title: Don't Let Anyone SEE Your Reflection 🪟
description:
Don't let anybody see your reflection in a window here. It does what you really want. A man on a diet walks past the bakery, and his reflection is face down in a cake. I don't have a reflection at all.

This spring my fiancée is getting our beach hut ready for summer, and every day her reflection in the hut window walks a little further away down the shore. Then one evening she's gone too, and the second deckchair outside our hut has turned to face me.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment CAKE if your reflection would be face down in one too.
